tool.text: Of course, these are our own soaring tools! tool.title: Gliders
tool.text: Here are links to free gliders that are all MUST have!($*$)($*$)[AS 33 Me (Schleicher)](https://flightsim.to/file/15090/as-33-me)($*$)[AS 33 Me Discussion thread on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/876129286057242624)($*$)($*$)[DG808s (DG-Flugzeugbau)](https://msfs.touching.cloud/mods/ms-dg-808s/)($*$)[DG808s Discussion thread on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/876129454378864660)($*$)($*$)[Discus-2c Standard](https://www.got-friends.com/collections/freeware/products/discus-2c-standard)($*$)[Discus-2c Discussion thread on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/876129574327574531)($*$)($*$)[Jonker JS3 15m and 18m](https://flightsim.to/file/56083/jonker-js3-rapture)($*$)[JS3 Discussion thread on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/1114179491984592917)($*$)($*$)[K7 (Schleicher)](https://flightsim.to/file/34815/schleicher-k7-glider)($*$)[K7 Discussion thread on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/984350484515147826)($*$)($*$)[LS4 (Rolladen-Schneider)](https://flightsim.to/file/27986/rolladen-schneider-ls4)($*$)[LS4 Discussion thread on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/942329570256908328)($*$)($*$)[ASK-21 (Schleicher)](https://inibuilds.com/products/f7-simulations-ask-21-msfs)($*$)[ASK-21 Discussion thread on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/1281329199176613909)

tool.title: SSC-Tracker
tool.text: The #1 task tracker with moving map and VR panel, to be used while flying a task in MSFS.($*$)[Download tracker zip file](https://www.ssc-tracker.org/updates/SSC-Tracker.zip)($*$)($*$)You will find a good discussion thread about it on the SSC Discord Server:($*$)[SSC-Tracker on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/1210244466628100106)

tool.title: B21 Task Planner
tool.text: This one is **THE** ultimate tool to get to know and use to create the flight plans for your tasks.($*$)https://xp-soaring.github.io/tasks/b21_task_planner/index.html($*$)($*$)You will find a good discussion thread about it on the SSC Discord Server:($*$)[B21 Task Planner on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/878323455584534558)

tool.title: NB21 Logger
tool.text: Soaring-oriented flight logger that creates IGC files with a lot of information in them.($*$)[NB21 Logger on FlightSim.to](https://flightsim.to/file/64628/nb21-logger)

tool.title: XCSoar
tool.text: Tool to be used while flying a task in MSFS. This tool is used in real life but there is an integration app you can use with it so it can work in MSFS.($*$)https://www.xcsoar.org/($*$)You will also need XCSimSoar which is the integration app to use between MSFS and XCSoar.($*$)[Google Drive for XCSimSoar](https://drive.google.com/u/0/uc?id=12cI8cNxAlZUNWZzdsqeELIJ9GnF31RdM)($*$)You will find a good discussion thread about it on the SSC Discord Server:($*$)[XCSoar on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/935541676825538580)

tool.title: Kinetic Assistant
tool.text: Useful tool to be used while flying (or perhaps more specifically to get you in the air?) in MSFS.($*$)[Kinetic Assistant Official Page](https://msfs.touching.cloud/mods/kinetic-assistant/)($*$)You will find a good discussion thread about it on the SSC Discord Server:($*$)[Kinetic Assistant on SSC](https://discord.com/channels/876123356385149009/876133299989385257)($*$)And here's a video that demonstrates the most valuable features of this app:($*$)[MSFS Glider Tow With and Without Kinetic Assistant](https://youtu.be/aHr24V9H-wY)

tool.title: FSPM VFR Map
tool.text: Adds your vario trails on the default VFR map for any glider.($*$)[FSPM VFR Map on FlightSim.to](https://flightsim.to/file/3181/fspm-vfr-map)

tool.title: SSC Soaring Weather
tool.text: Although each task in the library and in a **DPHX** package comes with its own weather file, frequently they are coming from a pre-made package of weather profiles.($*$)Also, these ready-to-go profiles can be used when you're designing tasks or doing some improv flights around the world.($*$)[SSC Soaring Weather on FlightSim.to](https://flightsim.to/file/56827/soaring-weather)

tool.title: Merlinor's 160 Soaring Weather Presets
tool.text: Here's another offering for pre-made weather profiles from @Merlinor. It can complement the SSC package above.($*$)[Merlinor's 160 Soaring Weather Presets on FlightSim.to](https://flightsim.to/file/77471/160-soaring-weather-presets)
